# PLAN — iteration 1
## Current state assessment

The incumbent uses 13 LUTs and 6 FFs, passes simulation, and has setup WNS −0.931 ns with hold WHS +0.091 ns, so timing is infeasible. The reported critical path runs from `rd_ptr` through distributed RAM read logic to `out_data[7]`; its delay also includes substantial clock insertion and output pad delay. Timing recovery is the first objective, with routed setup and hold closure and all verification gates required.

## Hypothesis

Register the FIFO head payload so `out_data` is driven directly from a register; this should remove the pointer-to-memory-read path from the output and improve setup slack, at the cost of additional FFs and head-update logic.

## Instruction for generator

In `sync_fifo_core`, add a parameterized head-data register and drive `out_data` from it instead of the asynchronous `mem[rd_ptr]` read; update it when a push enters an empty FIFO and when a pop advances to a remaining queued word. Handle the single-word case explicitly: when the only queued word is popped while a push is accepted on the same edge, load the new input as the head; when a pop advances through a larger FIFO, select the next oldest stored word. Preserve the existing pointers, occupancy, full simultaneous pop/push behavior, reset priority, stall stability, symbolic payload width, supported non-power-of-two depths, and top `// @latency 1` annotation; invalid-cycle `out_data` remains unspecified.
